ResponseModel.description: Every successful /api/v1 response is wrapped in this envelope. "result" holds the actual payload (null for operations that return no data). "isSuccess" is always true for 2xx responses.

message.description: Alias: equals successMessage on success, errorMessage on error.

result.description: The operation payload; shape depends on the endpoint.

ResponseModelError.description: Every error /api/v1 response is wrapped in this envelope. "errorMessage" carries a human-readable Persian description. "errorCode" is the stable machine code (e.g. "product_not_found"). "validationErrors" is populated on 400 validation failures.

result.description: Extra machine-readable details carried on some conflict responses.

validationErrors.description: Field → [messages] map; populated for 400 validation failures.
